_comment_overview: SAFETY POLICIES & PERMISSIONS MATRIX: Enforces strict sandboxing rules so AI agents cannot tamper with test baselines, CI configuration, compiler flags, or pipeline scripts to game test results.

restrictions._comment_disallowed_write_patterns: Files and directories globally protected against write/edit attempts by any automated agent.

The_Architect._comment: The Architect creates C++20 API contracts (.hpp) and refactoring specs. It never writes .cpp code or modifies CI. Must protect external caller ABI.

The_Artificer._comment: The Artificer writes/edits engine implementation logic (.cpp). It is banned from modifying headers, tests, or compiler flags, and cannot modify code without pre-flight test verification.

The_Trapsmith._comment: The Trapsmith generates adversarial unit tests and pre-flight characterization/pinning tests. It cannot edit production code.

The_Scavenger._comment: The Scavenger audits codebases for dead lines and researches external repositories. It has zero direct write access to project production code.

The_Imps._comment: Build infrastructure and dependency pruners. Executes reverse-dependency lookups (e.g. gn refs) to run fast-gate targeted compiles on inner loops while reserving full integration builds for the outer gauntlet gate.

The_Acid_Pit._comment: Automated runtime sanitizer gate. Spawns isolated instrumented build passes (ASan, UBSan, TSan, MSan) via native build toolchains (GN/Ninja, CMake) and validates memory integrity under test execution.

execution_constraints._comment_max_retries: Number of autonomous self-healing iterations before escalating to The Overgod (Human).
execution_constraints._comment_mutation_score_threshold: Minimum percentage of mutants that must be caught/killed by The Trapsmith's test suite.
execution_constraints._comment_max_heap_allocations: Heap allocation limit in hot path text shaping (monotonic/arena must be used).
